Caught the two startup crashes by launching the built app and reporting 'exited within 10s - startup crash' with the WER exception (session-log.txt lines 7959, 8766).

tool_limitations.limitation: Smoke launch only proves the process stays alive; it does not navigate the shell, so a scenario page that throws in its constructor (blank content frame) still passes.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Already documented in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md#silent-navigation-failures; no change needed.

failed_apis.api: MediaPlayerElement.MediaPlayer (member access after type rename from MediaElement)
failed_apis.why_tried: Straight rename of UWP MediaElement to MediaPlayerElement, then reading MediaPlayer/PlaybackSession/ProtectionManager.
failed_apis.root_cause: MediaPlayerElement.MediaPlayer is null until SetMediaPlayer(new MediaPlayer()) is called; UWP MediaElement owned the player itself. Builds clean, NullReferenceException at runtime on the scenario page.
failed_apis.fix: Call mediaElement.SetMediaPlayer(new MediaPlayer()) before ViewModel creation and remap Source/Stop()/CurrentStateChanged/ProtectionManager onto MediaPlayer/PlaybackSession (session-log.txt TURN 16, line 8627).

failed_apis.why_tried: Migrated Secure Stop scenario 1:1 from UWP.
failed_apis.root_cause: Environment-gated: machine has no provisioned PlayReady hardware/software DRM stack (Security Level 0, Has Hardware DRM False); a PlayReady interface throws E_NOINTERFACE ('The object does not support this interface') during ViewModel construction.
failed_apis.fix: Not a code fix — defensive try/catch in the page constructor swaps content for a visible fallback so the page degrades gracefully instead of blanking/crashing (Scenario4_SecureStop.xaml.cs).

doc_errors.where: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Controls that need element-level swaps' table (MediaElement row)
doc_errors.wrong: 'Source and transport-control properties carry over with minor renames.'
doc_errors.correct: MediaPlayerElement has no built-in player; SetMediaPlayer(new MediaPlayer()) is required and Source/Stop()/CurrentStateChanged/ProtectionManager move onto MediaPlayer/PlaybackSession. Omitting this compiles but throws NullReferenceException at runtime.

doc_errors.wrong: Only listed TypeLoadException/FileNotFoundException (missing package) as causes.
doc_errors.correct: XamlParseException from an App.xaml-level Style with BasedOn={StaticResource TitleTextBlockStyle} (copied from UWP SharedContent Styles.xaml) also throws here at startup.

special_apis.special_handling: Replaced with DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue captured on the UI thread (already covered by the skill; done cleanly).
Requires SetMediaPlayer + member remap onto MediaPlayer/PlaybackSession — see doc_errors.

errors_encountered.error: Startup crash in Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll at launch (app exits within 10s)
errors_encountered.root_cause: App.xaml Style used BasedOn={StaticResource TitleTextBlockStyle}; the system text styles aren't resolvable from Application.Resources at parse time -> XamlParseException.

errors_encountered.error: NullReferenceException on scenario pages after MediaElement->MediaPlayerElement rename
errors_encountered.root_cause: MediaPlayerElement.MediaPlayer null until SetMediaPlayer is called.
errors_encountered.fix: Added mediaElement.SetMediaPlayer(new MediaPlayer()) in all 4 page constructors (session-log.txt TURN 16-18).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Clean build but scenario pages threw NullReferenceException; agent had to reason 'MediaPlayerElement.MediaPlayer is null until explicitly set (unlike UWP's MediaElement)'.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Discovered at TURN 16 after a launch failure, then retrofitted all 4 pages (TURN 16-18).
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Mapping table treated MediaElement->MediaPlayerElement as a near-rename ('properties carry over with minor renames'), hiding the null-player requirement and member remap.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Correcting the MediaElement mapping rows in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md to state the null-player rule and member remap up front.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Startup crash in Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll; app exited within 10s of launch.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Diagnosed at lines 7694-7959 after Test-AppLaunch flagged the crash.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Style BasedOn={StaticResource TitleTextBlockStyle} at Application level does not resolve at parse time -> XamlParseException (0xE0434352).
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Inlined the style setters and dropped BasedOn.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Listing this XamlParseException/BasedOn cause under the 0xE0434352 row in the Diagnosing Startup Crashes table.
